# PartitionFunctionEncoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method of representing partition functions as input tensors or spike trains for neuromorphic processors, preserving topological features in the encoding. Allows iNEST hardware to process topological data efficiently, supporting real-time classification of topological order in physical or simulated systems.
